title: Return to One Familiar Three-Field Repair

lessons.title: One old form, one small correction
lessons.romanization: one familiar fictional three-field form repair
lessons.gloss: retrieve the old check-and-correct move without a new value or field

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture. You can listen to everything else now. I will say so again when we reach them, but leave these sections until you have stopped: Warm-up, Guided Practice and Wrap-up Recall.

segments.text: Use only these old fictional cards, never your own details. ਕ chooses A: age ੧੫, phone ੦੧੨ ੨੫੧, date ੧੫/੦੧/੨੦੨੫. ਖ chooses B: age ੨੫, phone ੦੨੫ ੧੨੫, date ੨੫/੦੨/੨੦੨੫. Read the printed A/B banks one line at a time, then keep them visible for the next step. This gentle return is not a scored A1 mock.

The card is ਖ. In this printed form, the age and date already match B; the phone's last two digits do not. Point to the single different line. Copy only its correction, ਫ਼ੋਨ: ੦੨੫ ੧੨੫, beside the form. Do not erase or rewrite the two correct lines.
Cover the bank and the guided correction. The card is now ਕ. Compare the printed three-field form below with the values you remember. Find the one different line. Leave the two matching lines alone.
Write the repaired line on fresh paper, from memory, with the bank still covered.

Now uncover the bank and check your repair: ਤਾਰੀਖ਼: ੧੫/੦੧/੨੦੨੫. The only change was the missing slash; every digit, age, and phone stays the same. This is a brief independent correction within a supported practice session, not an independent timed task, paper scoring, or human A1 validation.
